A) Jupiter  B) Earth  C) Mercury  D) Neptune

Bulk densities: Earth ~5.51 g/cm^3, Mercury ~5.43 g/cm^3, Jupiter ~1.33 g/cm^3, Neptune ~1.64 g/cm^3.

On reflection, the stronger candidate is c) mercury — committing to that.
